# ViraStack Start — TanStack Start Edition (i18n)

> TanStack Start + React 19 + Tailwind CSS 4 boilerplate with **Paraglide JS** i18n (`en`, `tr`), focused on clean architecture, UI/UX, and agent-ready developer experience. Auth and database/ORM are intentionally omitted — bring the solution that fits your project.

Built on TanStack Router file-based routing with type-safe loaders, nested layouts, and SSR via TanStack Start. English lives at `/` and `/users`, Turkish at `/tr` and `/tr/users`, through the optional `{-$lang}` route param; `/en` answers with a 301 to `/`, and the URL alone decides the language. UI primitives use **Base UI** (unstyled, accessible) styled with Tailwind CSS 4 design tokens. State is split by job: TanStack Query for server state, Zustand for client state, TanStack Router search params validated by Zod for URL state. Forms use React Hook Form + Zod. The home route renders a deletable `features/home` start page and `/users` renders a deletable `features/users` demo; both follow the canonical ViraStack feature tree. **ViraStack AI** (`@virastack/ai`) adds agent rules on scaffold; design skills come from [emilkowalski/skills](https://github.com/emilkowalski/skills) and [make-interfaces-feel-better](https://github.com/jakubkrehel/make-interfaces-feel-better).

- Tech stack: TanStack Start, TanStack Router, React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, TypeScript 6 (strict + `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`), Node.js `>=22.13.0`
- i18n: `@inlang/paraglide-js`; locales in `project.inlang/settings.json`, messages in `src/messages`, generated output in `src/paraglide`
- UI: Base UI, Sonner, Lucide React, `class-variance-authority`
- Data & state: TanStack Query 5, Zustand, TanStack Router search params
- Forms: React Hook Form + Zod (+ `@hookform/resolvers`)
- Testing: Vitest, React Testing Library, user-event, jest-dom, MSW (`src/test/`)
- API: Native `fetch` wrapper in `src/lib/api.ts` (`ApiError` with `message`, `status`, `data`); Axios is optional, not installed
- Env: Hand-rolled Zod schema in `src/env.ts` (`VITE_*` public vars)
- Tooling: ESLint 10, Prettier 3, Husky, Knip, Commitlint, Changesets, Vite 8
- Quality scripts: `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint` / `lint:ci`, `pnpm knip`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`
- ViraStack AI (via `npx @virastack/ai init`): `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/rules/virastack/`, `.cursor/rules/virastack/`, `.virastack/ai.json`
- Not included by default: Auth, DB/ORM, CSP

## Key Files & Entry Points
- [`src/routes/__root.tsx`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/routes/__root.tsx): Root route, document shell, providers, SEO head
- [`src/routes/{-$lang}/index.tsx`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/routes/%7B-%24lang%7D/index.tsx): Home route → `<HomePage />`
- [`src/routes/{-$lang}.tsx`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/routes/%7B-%24lang%7D.tsx): Validates the language and redirects `/en`
- [`src/routes/robots[.]txt.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/routes/robots%5B.%5Dtxt.ts): Dynamic robots.txt from `siteConfig`
- [`src/routes/sitemap[.]xml.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/routes/sitemap%5B.%5Dxml.ts): Dynamic sitemap from `siteConfig`
- [`src/routes/site[.]webmanifest.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/routes/site%5B.%5Dwebmanifest.ts): Dynamic web manifest from `siteConfig`
- [`project.inlang/settings.json`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/project.inlang/settings.json): Locales and Paraglide settings
- [`src/messages/en.json`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/messages/en.json): English messages
- [`src/messages/tr.json`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/messages/tr.json): Turkish messages
- [`src/helpers/localized-url.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/helpers/localized-url.ts): Language route param and `hreflang` links
- [`src/server.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/server.ts): Runs each request inside Paraglide's middleware
- [`src/start.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/start.ts): Global request middleware (baseline security headers)
- [`src/router.tsx`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/router.tsx): Router factory + TanStack Query SSR integration
- [`src/env.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/env.ts): Zod-validated environment schema (`VITE_*` public vars)
- [`src/config/site.config.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/config/site.config.ts): Site config (name, URL, links)
- [`src/config/seo.config.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/config/seo.config.ts): Default SEO meta helpers
- [`src/lib/api.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/lib/api.ts): Native `fetch` wrapper with retry & typed `ApiError`
- [`src/lib/query-client.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/lib/query-client.ts): QueryClient factory & defaults
- [`src/providers/Providers.tsx`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/providers/Providers.tsx): App-wide providers (Theme, Toaster)
- [`vite.config.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/vite.config.ts): Vite + TanStack Start + Paraglide + Tailwind

## Start Page and Users Demo (delete when building)
The home route composes `HomePage`; `/users` composes `UsersPage` and `UsersDirectory`.

- [`src/features/home/components/HomePage.tsx`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/features/home/components/HomePage.tsx): Start page
- [`src/features/home/constants/home.constants.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/features/home/constants/home.constants.ts): Stack list data and links
- [`src/features/home/components/StackList.tsx`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/features/home/components/StackList.tsx): Reads stack versions from package.json
- [`src/routes/{-$lang}/users.tsx`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/routes/%7B-%24lang%7D/users.tsx): Demo route with loader prefetch and validated search params
- [`src/features/users/components/UsersDirectory.tsx`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/features/users/components/UsersDirectory.tsx): List, search, pagination and states
- [`src/features/users/components/AddUserForm.tsx`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/features/users/components/AddUserForm.tsx): RHF + Zod form
- [`src/features/users/api/get-users.api.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/features/users/api/get-users.api.ts): DummyJSON list and search
- [`src/features/users/api/add-user.api.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/features/users/api/add-user.api.ts): DummyJSON add (does not save)
- [`src/features/users/hooks/use-users-params.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/features/users/hooks/use-users-params.ts): Page and search in the URL
- [`src/features/users/stores/favorites.store.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/features/users/stores/favorites.store.ts): Zustand favorites
- [`src/features/users/schemas/user.schema.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/features/users/schemas/user.schema.ts): Zod schemas
- [`src/features/users/schemas/users-params.schema.ts`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/features/users/schemas/users-params.schema.ts): Zod schema for the URL search params

To remove the demo: delete `src/features/users` and `src/routes/{-$lang}/users.tsx`, then update `src/features/home`. To remove the start page: also delete `src/features/home` and replace `src/routes/{-$lang}/index.tsx`.

## UI & Shared Layers
- [`src/components/ui`](https://github.com/virastack/start/tree/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/components/ui): Base UI primitives (Button, Input, Field, Dialog, Tabs, Skeleton, Label, Avatar, Table)
- [`src/components/shared`](https://github.com/virastack/start/tree/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/components/shared): Cross-feature components (ThemeToggle, LanguageSwitcher, NotFound, DefaultCatchBoundary)
- [`src/styles/tailwind.css`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/src/styles/tailwind.css): Tailwind v4 entry + design tokens
- Assets: [`public/logo.webp`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/public/logo.webp), [`public/og.png`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/public/og.png), [`public/favicon.ico`](https://github.com/virastack/start/blob/main/templates-i18n/tanstack/public/favicon.ico)

## Customization & Imports
- Search the project for `FIXME:` (site config, auth attachment on the API client).
- Edit `src/messages/*.json`, never the generated `src/paraglide`.
- Import from the defining file with the single `@/*` alias. There are no barrel files.
- Default scope is `features/[feature]/` — promote to global `src/` only when a second feature needs it. No cross-feature imports.

## ViraStack AI
- Install or refresh: `npx @virastack/ai init`
- `AGENTS.md`: Agent operating guide (all agents)
- `CLAUDE.md`: Claude Code entry point (`@AGENTS.md`)
- `.claude/rules/virastack/*.md`: Scoped coding rules (Claude Code auto-loads)
- `.cursor/rules/virastack/*.mdc`: Scoped coding rules (Cursor auto-loads)
- `.virastack/ai.json`: Installed rule manifest (commit it)
- Skills: [emilkowalski/skills](https://github.com/emilkowalski/skills) (7 design-engineering skills) + [make-interfaces-feel-better](https://github.com/jakubkrehel/make-interfaces-feel-better)
- Package: [`@virastack/ai`](https://github.com/virastack/ai)
